verdict.rationale: Postman lets teams write pre/post-response scripts and assertions to validate live responses (docs-12, docs-17) and run these in CI/CD via the CLI (docs-19, docs-6), and offers a governance check of API specs (docs-22), but there is no explicit built-in 'contract vs. live response' schema-diff feature—drift detection would need custom test scripts rather than a first-class contract-testing capability.
